candidates: When code contains a non-obvious workaround or hack (e.g., in build scripts or plugin utilities), include an inline comment explaining why the workaround is necessary and link to the relevant issue, PR discussion, or upstream bug report so future maintainers can understand the intent and revisit it if the underlying problem is fixed.

When measuring elapsed or wall-clock duration (e.g., timing build steps or async operations), prefer `console.time()`/`console.timeEnd()` or `performance.now()` over `Date.now()`. `Date.now()` reflects the system wall clock and is not monotonic, making it unsuitable for measuring time intervals.
